descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S17 「TC-20 的 AI 步骤（Save Note、Generate）的 AI 追踪和耗时，以及计数完整出来的时间」 AI trace and timing for TC-20's AI steps (Save Note, Generate), plus time to full counts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Each run records the build and which AI ran each AI step TC-20 exercises: the step-3 note (note model, and the backup model if one was used) and the pre-round processing behind Save Note (S08), so a …（UAT 3.1；UAT 3.9）
  • U8 Each Save Note and Generate run in TC-20 logs the AI call time (aiCallLog.providerMs) separately from the total (durationMs). Save Note targets 15 s or less in 9/10 runs. …（UAT 3.5）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given Local stack, standard fixture. A person runs one Save Note and one Generate Note & Finish per care setting (or reads the rows left by S08 and S09 once they run)

When After each Save Note and Generate, read the local aiCallLog rows for the fixture patient's calls (read-only, local stack only): model, fellBackFrom, providerMs, durationMs. Also time a cold dashboard load and the time from a status write to the tile moving

Then The run report names the build and, per call, the model that ran and the backup if one was used (3.1, 3.9), for the note and for the pre-round processing. Each call shows the AI time separately from the total (3.5). Save Note over 15 s, and any run over 30 s where providerMs is not most of durationMs, are flagged for review with Vikram. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.1 and 3.9 (record which AI ran each step) and 3.5 (AI time logged apart from the total; 15 s Save Note target; 30 s investigation limit). Timings are targets, not pass/fail: a slow run is flagged, never failed. U7 fails only if the trace is missing or contradicts what ran. …

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：manual。

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S17

AI trace and timing for TC-20's AI steps (Save Note, Generate), plus time to full counts

Tickets: none (UAT only)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status passed-partial → 通过（部分通过（判过的格子都通过，有一部分没跑 / 是模拟的））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：chromium spec. One real pre-round Save Note per care setting on a fresh account (real AI), then read diagnostics:list (the account's own aiCallLog rows: model, fellBackFrom, providerMs, durationMs) and time a cold dashboard load and a status write → tile move. Generate cell not run (forbidden locally; dev S15 records generateNote rows). — Save Note trace and timings are automatable; the Generate half is forbidden locally.

Detail:

6/6 judged cells pass, 4 recorded, 1 NOT RUN. Not run: Generate Note & Finish trace (both settings) (Generate is forbidden on the local stack (capabilities.json); dev S15 records notes.generateNote rows). Recorded: Hospital: Save Note time against the 15 s target / 30 s investigation limit = {"saveNoteWallMs":10403,"over15s":false,"slowNotVendor":[]} | Nursing Home: Save Note time against the 15 s target / 30 s investigation limit = {"saveNoteWallMs":12114,"over15s":false,"slowNotVendor":[]} | cold dashboard load (Hospital, 1 patient) = {"coldMs":6688} | status write → Complete tile moves = {"moveMs":1786,"beforeComplete":0}.

跑的时候（runNote）：1 of 3 runs: the Nursing Home Save Note left the text saved, with no summary and no error, for 90 s, during the same overload; not reproduced on rerun. Intermittent, not counted: in 4 Save Notes today (TC-20/S17 NH during the 14:4x overload; TC-21/S17 Hospital at 16:55; TC-11/S03 NH at 16:59 and 17:02 JST) the text was saved but the structured summary never arrived and no error was set within 90 s (preRoundProcessing stuck true, or no notesProcessedAt and no preRoundError); the retries were clean. No aiCallLog row was captured for those attempts, so the cause (model latency vs app) is open; worth watching on dev.

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack: it reads aiCallLog with the admin key (backend-read-admin) and times actions (action-timing); dev has no admin key.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
